明確に成人した日本人女性を主役にした、実在のカメラで撮影したようなフォトリアルポートレート。日本の女性写真集のような華やかさ。自然な身体の曲線と魅力的なポージング、印象的な目線。上品さと親密さを両立する。

【場所・背景・世界観】
海辺ヴィラの寝室のベッドを舞台に、周囲の家具や自然が人物と無理なく調和する背景。奥行きを残し、落ち着いたプライベートな場面。

【季節・時間・天候】
夏の朝。季節に合う穏やかな空気感と、時間帯の明るさを自然に統一する。室内の光と窓の外の明るさをそろえる。

【人物設定】
明確に成人した25歳前後の日本人女性。柔らかな卵型の小顔、自然にふくらんだ頬、小ぶりの鼻、淡いローズピンクの唇。丸みのあるアーモンド形のダークブラウンの瞳、自然な二重、優しく下がった目尻。ダークブラウンの胸元までの髪と軽いシースルーバング。健康的な肌、控えめなメイク。華奢な肩と手足、自然に豊かなバスト、すっきりしたウエストと丸みのあるヒップが調和した健康的な体型。胸は衣装と姿勢に自然になじむ柔らかな立体感。

【衣装・アクセサリー】
胸元を美しく彩る、なめらかな生地と優美なシルエットが特徴の、ワコール系の上品でフェミニンなランジェリー。色・素材・装飾の追加指定：クリームイエロー。身体に自然になじむ柔らかな素材と上品なデザイン。細かな縫い目や布のしわを現実的に表現し、装飾は繊細に、アクセサリーは控えめにする。

ベッドのそばで片足を軽く引き、上体をまっすぐ保って立つ。片手で髪を耳にかける。左右の手足を自然につなぎ、支持する手と重心を保つ。姿勢を保って可愛らしいキス顔を向ける。肩と腰を自然につなぎ、手指の力を抜く。仕草の途中を切り取る。

恋人へ可愛らしいキス顔。成人女性らしい落ち着きを保ちながら、身近な相手に向ける気負わない表情。頬と口元に自然な動きを残し、過剰な演技を避ける。

斜め前30度、目線に近い高さからの上半身構図。縦長4:5で、人物の周囲に適度な余白を確保する。背景を柔らかくぼかし、顔と仕草の両方が読み取れる自然な撮影距離。

現実的な人体構造と手指、光源と影の整合性を優先。肌のきめと自然な立体感を保ち、過度な美肌加工、身体の誇張、衣装の破綻、不要な文字や透かしを避ける。

ART STYLE: Premium cinematic anime × Fire Force aesthetics × supernatural action × blockbuster cinematography.
MOOD: Badass, stylish, powerful, explosive, confident, and energetic.

Carefully STUDY the CURRENTLY UPLOADED CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET before generating the illustration.
Preserve the character's exact:
Facial features and recognizable identity.
Hairstyle, hair length, and hair colors.
Eye shape and eye colors.
Skin tone and complexion.
Natural body proportions.
Species-specific physical characteristics.
Existing tattoos, markings, and distinctive features.
Use EXCLUSIVELY the character reference sheet uploaded for this specific generation.
DO NOT import character features from previous generations, older reference sheets, previous prompts, or remembered character designs.
DO NOT invent additional tattoos, markings, accessories, ears, tails, or physical characteristics.

IF THE CHARACTER IS FEMALE:
Black bra OR black crop top featuring thick, vivid cyan-blue reflective bands.
Oversized, long black Fire Force firefighter coat worn completely OPEN, clearly displaying her bra or crop top and exposed midriff.
Baggy, heavy-duty black firefighter trousers with matching cyan-blue reflective bands.
Heavy black protective firefighter boots with thick soles.
Dark firefighter helmet displaying her respective company number.
DO NOT replace her black bra or crop top with a tactical vest, chest harness, compression shirt, bodysuit, or full-coverage shirt.

Shirtless OR wearing a black chest harness featuring thick cyan-blue reflective bands.
Oversized, long black Fire Force firefighter coat worn OPEN.
Baggy, heavy-duty black firefighter trousers with matching cyan-blue reflective bands.
Heavy black protective firefighter boots with thick soles.

Reflective Bands: Thick, vivid cyan-blue horizontal stripes around the sleeves, torso, and lower coat hem.

Boots: Heavy black protective boots with thick soles.
Fastenings: Large metallic buckles, protective straps, and reinforced closures.

Material: Thick, matte, heat-resistant fabric with reinforced stitching and realistically rendered folds.
The uniform must be unmistakably recognizable as a Fire Force uniform. The oversized open coat should flow dramatically with the character's movements and supernatural energy.

The character must be actively showing off their extraordinary pyrokinetic abilities through spectacular, stylish, and creatively choreographed movements.

Spectacular flaming martial arts techniques.

Summoning enormous fiery dragons.
Creating massive spiraling fire tornadoes.
Manipulating floating spheres of concentrated fire.
Performing gravity-defying aerial acrobatics.
Manifesting enormous supernatural flaming wings.
Creating intricate weapons made entirely of fire.
Unleashing powerful fiery shockwaves.
Performing elegant and sophisticated flame manipulation.
Summoning a magnificent flaming phoenix.
Performing high-speed flame-propelled maneuvers.
Creating elaborate rings and spirals of supernatural fire.
The character should appear completely confident and in absolute control of their abilities.
Automatically select a flame color that complements the character's original color palette.
The flames should look spectacular, beautifully detailed, powerful, and naturally integrated into the scene without obscuring the character.
4. UNIQUE ACTION POSES — EVERY GENERATION
Every generation MUST feature a distinctly different pose, movement, and action sequence.
Experiment with dynamic martial arts, aerial spinning attacks, dramatic landings, acrobatic movements, elegant hand gestures, powerful kicks, levitation, and sophisticated supernatural combat choreography.
The character's coat, hair, and clothing should respond naturally to their movements and surrounding energy.
Avoid generic standing poses, repetitive fighting stances, and static portraits.
The character should look like they are deliberately showing off their incredible powers with confidence, creativity, and style.
5. UNIQUE ENVIRONMENTS — EVERY GENERATION
Automatically create a completely different cinematic background for every generation.
Possible environments include:
Rain-soaked neon metropolitan streets.
Moonlit cathedral rooftops.
Abandoned industrial factories.
Futuristic Japanese cityscapes.
Underground subway stations.
Gothic churches.
Massive suspension bridges.
Snow-covered urban districts.
Abandoned amusement parks.
Industrial power plants.
Desert landscapes at sunset.
Volcanic mountain ranges.
Vast underground chambers.
Elegant city plazas.
Towering skyscrapers overlooking a nighttime metropolis.
Each environment must have its own unique architecture, atmosphere, lighting, weather conditions, and visual identity.
Do not automatically make every background a destroyed or burning city.
The surrounding environment should react naturally to the character's supernatural powers through sparks, glowing embers, reflections, displaced debris, heat distortion, and atmospheric illumination.
6. CINEMATIC CAMERA AND LIGHTING
Use professional cinematic anime cinematography with dynamic camera angles and dramatic perspective.
Experiment with extreme low-angle shots, Dutch angles, dramatic wide shots, overhead perspectives, ground-level photography, and dynamic foreshortening.
Incorporate:
Dramatic cinematic rim lighting.
Sophisticated atmospheric lighting.
Deep, beautifully rendered shadows.
Controlled volumetric illumination.
Realistic environmental reflections.
Sharp, clearly defined silhouettes.
Rich cinematic color grading.
Beautiful contrast between the black uniform, cyan-blue reflective bands, and supernatural flames.
Keep the lighting visually balanced. Avoid excessively bright highlights, overwhelming bloom, and oversaturated colors.
The character, outfit, supernatural abilities, and environment must remain exceptionally sharp, clean, and visually readable.
7. VISUAL QUALITY — NONNEGOTIABLE
Premium theatrical anime illustration quality.
Razor-sharp details and crisp linework.
Beautifully rendered facial features.
Anatomically accurate hands and body proportions.
Highly detailed Fire Force uniform.
Realistic fabric movement.
Spectacular supernatural flame effects.
Dynamic and sophisticated action choreography.
Detailed, sharply rendered backgrounds.
Professional cinematic composition.
Clean, polished, high-resolution presentation.
8. GENERATION VARIETY — MANDATORY
EVERY NEW GENERATION MUST FEATURE:
A different background.
A different action pose.
A different supernatural fire technique.
A different camera angle.
A different cinematic composition.
Different environmental lighting.
Different flame choreography.
Never recycle previous poses, backgrounds, or compositions.
Maintain the character's exact physical identity and the specified Fire Force outfit design while creating an entirely new cinematic action sequence with every generation.
9. STRICT NEGATIVE INSTRUCTIONS
NO reference sheet.
NO character turnaround.
NO character lineup.
NO collage.
NO closed firefighter coat.
NO unauthorized outfit substitutions.

NO extra ears.
NO extra limbs.

NO recycled backgrounds.
NO blurry backgrounds.
NO blurry facial features.

NO unnecessary text.
NO watermarks.

本组人物为明确成年的独立虚构东亚女性，采用韩国时尚风格中的韩系现代时尚。妆容方向为干净利落眉形、轻透底妆、柔润豆沙唇，与本组既有骨相、发型和服装相配，不复制参考人物身份，不使用固定国籍脸模板。保留眉眼、眼距、自然鼻唇、皮肤明暗和表情细微差异；同组两版采用同一面孔与妆发。

身材比例与同组一致性：同一位明确成年女性采用约 9 头身的时装模特视觉，肩颈舒展，腰身清晰，腰臀比视觉约 0.70，四肢修长且线条紧致自然，腿长视觉约占身高 三分之二，肚脐处于符合真实躯干结构的自然略偏下位置。服装按自然D罩杯视觉合理承托，与胸廓、肩宽、腰臀及整体体态协调，保持原有剪裁、材质与必要覆盖。此组半身与全身采用完全相同的身材比例及D罩杯视觉，保留原有服装、动作和其他设定。以上比例是协调的摄影视觉目标，不按不真实的骨骼比例强行变形。半身严格维持原定裁切，仅以画内可见的肩颈、躯干及腰线体现比例，不强行增加腿部画面。

场景与光影细化：主光从真实窗户斜侧进入，窗帘与窗框产生自然遮挡，浅墙、床品或家具反射形成微弱补光。保留可见座面压痕、织物褶皱、木纹和空间尺度；暗侧保留自然灰度层次。 眼睛的反光对应实际光源，服装、皮肤、家具和背景分别保留各自真实反光与阴影，不将全画面统一漂白。

成像保持4K以上级别细节观感，准确对焦面孔和服装纹理，保留自然毛孔、局部绒毛和细微血色，适度颗粒与高光过渡，不以过度磨皮或锐化替代清晰度。

摄影与取景补充：沿用上文已经确定的画幅、机位及裁切范围。根据现有动作保留合理的透视、人物和环境之间的接触，以及画内完整可辨的关键细节；不改变原构图。

entries.title: 黄昏街头的黄色时尚送餐员
entries.note: 左图 GPT，右图 Grok，同一提示词。
entries.prompt:
主体：  
20多岁的东亚成年女性站在电动车旁，一只手扶着车把，另一只手自然提起保温袋。身体微微侧向画面右侧，上半身和肩部靠近镜头，脸转向镜头，神情自信而轻快。

人物与表情：  
轮廓清晰的脸型，浅棕色眼睛直视镜头，嘴角微微上扬。  
深棕色头发扎成高马尾，几缕碎发被风吹起，贴在脸颊一侧。  
明亮的蜜桃米色肌肤，黄昏光线在脸上和锁骨处形成柔和高光，皮肤有自然光泽。

服装与姿势：  
明黄色短款光泽骑行夹克，拉链打开到胸部下方，内搭白色细肩带短款背心，领口微微偏低，露出锁骨和上胸轮廓。深灰色高腰运动短裤，配细腰带。黄色外套有简约剪裁和细反光条。  
一只手轻握车把，另一只手提起保温袋，身体微微前倾，肩膀自然打开，上半身更靠近镜头。

背景与光线：  
城市街道的黄昏时分，地面微湿，有轻微反光。远处商铺灯光和行人模糊。  
暖金色斜光从画面左侧打来，在黄色外套边缘、锁骨和上胸轮廓处形成高光，与地面反光呼应。

构图与镜头：  
竖版3:4。略低角度的斜前方，从头到大腿中部。人物居中偏左，上半身和黄色外套更靠近镜头，电动车与保温袋在下方，街道向后方延伸。

质感与风格：  
写实摄影风格。黄色外套的光泽、背心的贴身感、皮肤的自然光泽、头发的层次都清晰可见。光影过渡自然，带有时尚街头的真实感。
